steps.what: Set up and mount photographic equipment

tasks.design: The photographer sets up, mounts, or installs photographic equipment and cameras. The work stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} mounts a camera.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer sets up the equipment on site.
tasks.still_hard: Setting up the camera stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the mount does not fit the camera.
tasks.altitude: The setup stays at full effort.

reach.task: Carry the case the photographer names

evidence.claim: Setting up, mounting, or installing cameras stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with equipment and ends when the photographer has set it up, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Directing another worker is a different task.
research_questions: How often did a mount not fit?

already_counted.description: Setting up the equipment is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the setup adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every camera is still set up by the photographer. High: the same setup remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study the assignment with the client

steps.what: Determine project goals, locations, and equipment needs
Keep studying assignments and consulting with clients
Consult advertising staff about those equipment needs

tasks.design: The photographer determines project goals, locations, and equipment needs by studying assignments and consulting with clients or advertising staff. The conversation stays at full effort. Nobody is scored. Nothing in {DOCS} sets the goal.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer reads the assignment and talks with the client.
tasks.still_hard: The goal, the location, and the equipment need stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not accept a goal the assignment does not support.
tasks.altitude: The consultation stays at full effort. Clients and staff are not scored.

reach.task: Say what the assignment must achieve

evidence.claim: Studying an assignment and consulting a client or advertising staff stays a conversation.

assumptions: The work starts with an assignment and ends when the photographer has set the goal, or stops.
No score is stored. Upkeep is zero.
Booking the location is a different task.
unknowns: Which assignments need advertising staff in the room.
research_questions: Which goals did the photographer refuse?

already_counted.description: Consulting with clients is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every assignment is still studied by the photographer. High: the same consultation remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform maintenance tasks necessary for the equipment

tasks.design: The photographer performs maintenance tasks necessary to keep equipment working properly. The work stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} services the camera.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer services the equipment by hand.
tasks.still_hard: Servicing the equipment stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the task is not the one the equipment needs.
tasks.altitude: The maintenance stays at full effort.

reach.task: Bring the equipment that needs service
reach.learn: Which tasks were the wrong ones.

assumptions: The work starts with equipment and ends when the photographer has serviced it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A test before a job is a different task.
unknowns: Which maintenance the photographer does, and which goes to a workshop.
research_questions: How often was the task the wrong one for the equipment?

already_counted.description: Performing the maintenance is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the maintenance adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every maintenance task is still done by the photographer. High: the same maintenance remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select and assemble equipment and required background properties
Assemble according to subjects, materials, and conditions

tasks.design: The photographer selects and assembles equipment and required background properties, according to subjects, materials, and conditions. The assembly stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} builds the set.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer chooses and assembles the set.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the equipment and the background stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer rejects a background the subject does not support.
tasks.altitude: The assembly stays at full effort.

reach.task: Fetch the item the photographer names

evidence.claim: Selecting and assembling equipment and backgrounds stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a subject and ends when the photographer has assembled the set, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Lighting the set is a different task.
unknowns: Which backgrounds are kept in the studio.
research_questions: Which backgrounds did the photographer reject?

already_counted.description: Selecting and assembling the set is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the assembly adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every set is still assembled by the photographer. High: the same assembly remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
